quickAnswer: Türkiye operates 19 Free Trade Zones (Serbest Bölgeler) positioned outside its normal customs territory to support export manufacturing, transit logistics, and specialized tech hubs. Flagship zones include Istanbul Atatürk Airport (İSBİ), Aegean (ESBAŞ), Antalya (ASBAŞ), and Mersin (MESBAŞ), offering customs and VAT relief plus corporate and payroll tax exemptions for qualifying export manufacturers.

body.text: Which major Free Zones (Istanbul Atatürk Airport, Aegean/ESBAŞ, Antalya, Mersin) serve foreign companies?

Four flagship zones anchor foreign investment across distinct supply chains: Istanbul Atatürk Airport Free Zone (İSBİ) specializes in IT, software, and high-value air-cargo services; İzmir's Aegean Free Zone (ESBAŞ) leads export manufacturing across aerospace, automotive, and electronics; Antalya (ASBAŞ) dominates superyacht construction and marine refit; and Mersin (MESBAŞ) operates its own Mediterranean port terminal for regional transit trade.

Per the [Ministry of Trade Free Zones Outlook](https://www.trade.gov.tr/free-zones/general-outlook), private or public-private operators run Türkiye's 19 zones under Ministry oversight. [ESBAŞ in İzmir](https://esbas.com.tr/?language=en) sits 4 km from İzmir Airport and 12 km from İzmir Port, while [İSBİ](https://gsl.org/en/offers/free-zone-company-registration-in-istanbul-ataturk-airport-free-zone-isbi-turkey/) focuses on specialized IT. [ASBAŞ](https://www.asbas.com.tr/dunya-gazetesi-antalya-serbest-bolgesi-yabanci-yat-ureticilerinin-radarinda/) serves marine and medical clusters, and [MESBAŞ](https://www.turklim.org/en/turklim-members/mesbas-mersin-free-zone/) operates its own deep-water terminal beside Mersin Port.

body.text: What corporate tax, VAT and customs exemptions apply?

Goods entering a Turkish Free Zone from abroad are exempt from customs duties and import VAT, while Turkish inputs sold into a zone qualify as VAT-free exports. Under Law No. 3218 and 2026 Law No. 7577, manufacturers receive corporate tax exemption on export and zone-to-zone sales, plus wage tax relief at 85%+ FOB export.

Per the [Ministry of Trade](https://www.trade.gov.tr/free-zones/advantages-of-the-turkish-free-zones) and [Invest in Türkiye](https://www.invest.gov.tr/en/investmentguide/pages/investment-zones.aspx), zone users also receive property tax relief, unlimited storage, and free profit repatriation. As [Systems CPA](https://www.systemscpa.com/insights/free-zone-company-accountant-turkey/) and [Çelikel CPA](https://celikelcpa.com/company-formation-in-turkey/) note, non-production licences issued after February 6, 2004 carry no corporate tax exemption, and mainland sales incur standard import duties and corporate tax.

Who is eligible to lease or operate inside a Turkish Free Zone?

Both 100% foreign-owned companies, joint ventures, and Turkish legal entities—as well as branches of foreign firms—may operate inside a Turkish Free Zone after securing an Operating Licence (Faaliyet Ruhsatı) from the Ministry of Trade's General Directorate of Free Zones. Applicants can lease ready warehouses and offices from the zone operator or lease land to build custom facilities.

Operating Licence durations follow standard Ministry terms: tenant users receive 20-year licences for manufacturing and 15 years for trading or services, while investor users constructing their own premises receive 45 years for production and 30 years for other activities. Applications require a detailed business plan, projected export ratios, and a USD 5,000 application fee deposited to the Central Bank's special free-zone account (refunded if declined).
How do you schedule an exploratory visit with zone management?

Schedule exploratory visits two to three weeks in advance by submitting your company profile, NACE activity scope, square-metre requirements, and projected export share to the zone operator's business development team (such as ESBAŞ, ASBAŞ, or MESBAŞ). Because Free Zones are fenced customs territories, visitor passes must be pre-cleared at the zone gate before entry.
Use this exploratory visit checklist before touring candidate zones:

items: Define your licence model: Clarify early whether you need a production licence or a general trading/warehousing licence.
Request space & utility sheets: Ask zone management for current lease rates, power capacity, and build-to-suit land availability before flying.
Compare two zones side by side: Pair an Istanbul or İzmir visit with Mersin or Antalya to benchmark freight transit times to your target markets.
Pair with independent advisors: Schedule a debrief with a Turkish SMMM (CPA) and customs broker immediately after zone tours to verify actual 2026 tax eligibility.

faq.q: How many Free Trade Zones currently operate in Türkiye?
faq.a: According to the Republic of Türkiye Ministry of Trade, 19 Free Zones operate across Türkiye near major seaports, international airports, and industrial corridors.

faq.q: Do pure trading or warehousing companies get the Free Zone corporate tax exemption?
faq.a: No. Under Law No. 3218, the corporate income tax exemption applies to manufacturing users on qualifying export and free-zone sales; general trading licences issued after February 6, 2004 do not receive this exemption.

faq.q: What changed in 2026 for Turkish Free Zone manufacturing tax rules?
faq.a: Under Law No. 7577 (published April 17, 2026 and effective from January 1, 2026), manufacturers' profits from sales inside the same free zone and to other Turkish free zones regained corporate tax exemption alongside foreign exports.

faq.q: Can a Turkish Free Zone company sell products into the Turkish domestic market?
faq.a: Yes, though goods moving from a Free Zone into mainland Türkiye are treated as imports subject to standard Turkish customs duties, import VAT, and corporate tax on domestic-sale profits.

faq.q: How long are Turkish Free Zone Operating Licences valid?
faq.a: Ministry of Trade rules grant tenant users 20-year licences for manufacturing and 15 years for other activities, while investor users who build their own facilities receive 45 years for manufacturing and 30 years for other activities.
